Boulder group remains in its original lower-left location around x110..445,y625..789. Fallen log remains in original location around x650..945,y630..780. These coordinates are preservation guides, not instructions to resize any object. Preserve both original tree crowns and all original branches, mossy boulders, bushes and the fallen log with attached moss and mushrooms. Preserve original outline, size, colors, intrinsic shading and upper-left sunset lighting. Remove all grass carpet, dirt, paths, loose small ground stones, floor vegetation, every contact/cast ground shadow and all background scenery. Isolated distinct bushes may remain, but no island of floor or grass under any object. Replace gaps between leaves and branches with the same exact pure green. Finish obscured object bases cleanly with minimal necessary completion. Remove partial unrelated objects at scene crop edges. Keep original green borders and all sheet positions unchanged. Absolutely uniform pure #00ff00 background, no noise, texture, gradient, halo, glow, blur or shadow. Preserve the original hand-drawn painted 2D style, no style transformation, no new objects, no labels.
